key_insight: A Mamdani fuzzy controller can adaptively tune FSW tool tilt angle in real time from sensor feedback to reduce weld defects and improve joint quality.
engineering_relevance: This enables more robust CNC-based friction stir welding by linking torque, temperature, and plunge-depth deviation directly to automatic tilt correction.
method: Inputs: torque, temperature, and plunge depth deviation.
Mamdani fuzzy inference with triangular membership functions and expert rules.
Centroid defuzzification to compute tilt-angle adjustments in MATLAB simulation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a sample output of 0.224° for 10 Nm torque, 45 °C temperature, and 0.5 mm plunge deviation, with surface plots showing smooth control behavior over -0.4° to +0.5°.
watch_item: The results are simulation-based, so real-world performance will depend on sensor quality, latency, and integration with the welding machine dynamics.
paper_title: Advancing Tilt Angle Control in Friction Stir Welding using Fuzzy Logic
